title: ETH Defends $2.4K Support Despite Weakening US Buying Pressure: Ethereum Price Analysis
summary: Ethereum is attempting to recover after a sharp sweep below the $2.4K support region, now trading around $2.45K. The rebound has brought the price back to the upper boundary of a key demand zone, but the market still needs to show that buyers can hold this area before the broader recovery can be considered back […]
